cases.title: Original balanced design
cases.note: 20 deterministic mean-reward rows, exactly matching behavior frequencies. Known target 0.78 only for the unedited design; no random-trial claim.

cases.title: Unobserved supported-by-model action
cases.note: Target puts positive mass on an action with zero behavior support. Numeric direct/DR output does not identify its reward nonparametrically.

cases.title: Zero observed target mass
cases.note: All observed target weights are zero. SNIPS is undefined; direct and DR still return numbers. The full behavior vectors have support.

cases.title: One large weight, opposite residuals
cases.note: A selected rare-action row dominates weight mass; negative DR correction is allowed. Higher ESS after clipping need not improve value accuracy. No population truth specified.

cases.title: On-policy arithmetic control
cases.note: Original target equals behavior, so raw weights are one. Clipping below one changes IPS/DR, although SNIPS retains the reward mean.

cross_fitted_seeded_log.scope: Point estimates for one fixed target policy, not a confidence bound or safe deployment decision. Requires correct logging propensities, action/reward consistency, relevant context, target support and appropriate sampling assumptions. Reward predictions must be trained independently or cross-fitted for usual DR theory; schema cannot verify this. SNIPS is finite-sample biased. Clipping can bias IPS/DR and changes the estimator. ESS is descriptive, not a validity certificate. Support checks apply only to supplied observed contexts; no hidden-confounding or unseen-context check.

cross_fit_diagnostics.scope: Categorical cell means with a fixed pseudo-count prior, not a Bayesian interval. Each prediction excludes its entire row fold. Row-iid splitting only: no group/time leakage protection. Independent rows, fixed hyperparameters, correct propensities, relevant contexts and target support remain assumptions. No tuning, propensity fitting, confidence interval or guarantee that the reward model is correct.

original_demo.scope: Selected two-context/two-action development fixtures. Balanced design exactly matches behavior frequencies and uses deterministic mean rewards; not a random trial. Seeded log uses true reward expectations as an oracle reward model, not a learned or cross-fitted model. An additional arm learns categorical cell means with five out-of-fold splits, seed 17, fixed prior mean .5 and strength 1. Same noisy log, not a separate test or tuned estimator selection. No estimator accuracy benchmark or causal proof.
